column1: # tests/ports.tsv - manifest of every language port.
#   3. build      compile / syntax-check command; empty = run directly.
#   4. run        command to run the port. Placeholders: %SRC%, %BIN%, %DIR%.
#   5. crash sed  sed expression replacing the '# CRASH-INJECT-POINT'
#                 marker line in the tick loop with code that aborts the
#                 program unexpectedly; empty = crash test not applicable.
#   6. crash rc   expected exit code of the crashed variant (default 42)
#   7. flags      comma-separated: skip-pty (pty tests not supported)
